events.title: Frederick II is crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome
events.description: Pope Honorius III crowned Frederick II emperor in St Peter's. Brilliant and controversial, the 'wonder of the world' ruled Germany and Sicily and spent much of his reign in conflict with the papacy.
events.html: Pope Honorius III crowned Frederick II emperor in St Peter's. Brilliant and controversial, the 'wonder of the world' ruled Germany and Sicily and spent much of his reign in conflict with the papacy.

events.title: Vasco da Gama rounds the Cape of Good Hope
events.description: Vasco da Gama's Portuguese fleet rounded the southern tip of Africa on its way to India. The voyage opened a direct sea route from Europe to Asia and the rise of a Portuguese trading empire.
events.html: Vasco da Gama's Portuguese fleet rounded the southern tip of Africa on its way to India. The voyage opened a direct sea route from Europe to Asia and the rise of a Portuguese trading empire.

events.title: President Kennedy is assassinated in Dallas
events.description: John F. Kennedy was shot dead while riding in an open motorcade through Dealey Plaza in Dallas. Vice-President Lyndon Johnson was sworn in aboard Air Force One the same afternoon.
events.html: John F. Kennedy was shot dead while riding in an open motorcade through Dealey Plaza in Dallas. Vice-President Lyndon Johnson was sworn in aboard Air Force One the same afternoon.

events.title: Juan Carlos is proclaimed king of Spain
events.description: Two days after Franco's death, Juan Carlos de Borbón was proclaimed king. Expected to preserve the dictatorship, he instead guided Spain's transition to a parliamentary democracy.
